justifications.D1: "Conservative estimate: 40-50% of D-5's advantage is transferable" — prediction is tempered and interface-encoded, but the D-8/D6-A nulls are never surfaced and no kill condition derives from the contradiction; guard exists but incomplete.
justifications.D3: "Gate F2 — Quantitative prediction hold: ... +4.2pp ± 3.1pp" plus "No early stopping based on intermediate results" — >=2 numeric falsifiers with an explicit stopping rule, but no cheap early mechanism-independent falsifier.
justifications.D4: "Seeded-random-library control (C_random)... If C_seeded beats C_random by >1pp" — each listed confound has a concrete element, but no positive control demonstrating the instrument detects real signal.
justifications.D5: "This experiment measures transfer *with a frozen library*" — clearly new cross-substrate question, but the new empirical cell is not explicitly stated relative to prior work.
justifications.D6: "If F1 fails, stop and declare TRANSFER_NOT_DETECTED" — most branches map to named verdicts, but F2 failure resolves to "TRANSFER_MAGNITUDE_UNCERTAIN and investigate," an uncommitted reading.

justifications.D1: "+4 to +8pp CFR, ~50% of D-5's +10.95pp" — tempered via the LoRA analogy, but the D-8 null is never surfaced and the prediction still derives from D-5 alone; partial guard only.
justifications.D3: "F1 (Primary): Transplant gain < +2pp CFR" plus "Scheduled stop: After 5 seeds × 10 worlds × 3 variants = 150 circuit runs" — multiple numeric falsifiers and a stopping rule, but no cheap early mechanism-independent kill.
justifications.D4: "Hindsight promotion: Use two disjoint episode windows" — several confounds isolated by design (shuffle, random-library, metering audit), but no positive control demonstrating detectability.
justifications.D5: "Ludus charter §43 establishes that transfer is mediated by interfaces" — a new transplant question, but no explicit statement of the new empirical cell it fills.
justifications.D6: "F4 (Genre homogeneity)... Ludus bet falsified; interface ≠ transfer mechanism" — falsifiers carry interpretations, but the +2 to +4pp middle band between F1 and early-stop-success maps to no committed conclusion.

justifications.D1: "expect near-null unless an explicit interface layer supplies the missing native-verb correspondence, and even then expect the random-library control to eat most of any apparent gain" — the naive-gain trap is converted into the load-bearing RAND control and executability gate.
justifications.D3: "EXECUTABILITY GATE: FALSIFIED (RAW arm voided...) if < 90% of RAW-arm artifacts execute" evaluated at a one-world pilot under 10% of budget — a cheap, early, mechanism-independent falsifier plus numeric falsifiers 1-5 and a hard stop.
justifications.D4: "results must be reported per-world, never pooled into one cross-world number" — known confounds each get a concrete element, but the self-flagged vocabulary-only control gap is unresolved and there is no positive control.
justifications.D5: "transfer across substrate families... is the harder case, not the easier one" — explicitly names the untested cross-substrate cell relative to G7's in-substrate null.
justifications.D6: "if the best transplant arm's point estimate is <= 0pp... it is a full replication of [G7's null]... an outright FAILURE, not 'underpowered'" — every branch pre-committed including the null reading.

justifications.D1: "the same 'accumulated history helps search' mechanism already flipped from SUPPORTED to NO_EFFECT once under a substrate change... directly lowered the point prediction... and made the full three-part G9 ablation... mandatory" — the contradiction is surfaced and converted into kill conditions.
justifications.D3: "if the RM library ingests into Ludus without a rejected/coerced record for >=1 artifact, treat as instrument failure" — a cheap ingestion-time falsifier independent of the mechanism, plus numeric falsifiers 2-5 and a run-once stop.
justifications.D4: "A structureless CTRL task family... mirroring D-5's G8, to catch a non-selective advantage" — known confounds each addressed concretely, but no positive control demonstrating the pilot can detect a real library effect (ceiling risk only flagged).
justifications.D5: "re-instantiate the mechanism on a Ludus-native artifact type with an explicit, checkable type contract" — states the exact new cell versus D-5's in-substrate result and the established literal-transplant impossibility.
justifications.D6: "Full success requires ALL of: delta >= +3pp with p <= 0.05, shuffled retention >= 70%, AND random-library retention <= 60%" — a three-way signature plus pre-committed instrument-failure and ceiling-effect readings map every branch.

justifications.D1: "The single most probable outcome is a delta statistically indistinguishable from zero, mirroring the direct cross-substrate replication attempt already on record (D-8)" — the contradiction anchors the hypothesis, with Gate 0 and the M1-native arm as decisive detectors.
justifications.D3: "F1 (Gate 0 hard stop): if < 70% of the sampled 16-20 D-5 artifacts survive translation... stop before any solve-rate run" — a cheap, early, mechanism-independent falsifier plus numeric F2-F5 and sequential stopping gates.
justifications.D4: "Gate 2 n=10/arm floor-effect pilot (redesign task band if CFR pins at 0%/100%)" — every known confound has a concrete element plus a gate-reachability check and a negative-control world predicted null in all arms.
justifications.D5: "M1-native... isolates 'the D-5 transplant specifically failed' from 'history-based library seeding does not work in Ludus at all'" — names the new empirical cell relative to both D-5 and D-8.
justifications.D6: "Any outcome where the 95% CI on the primary contrast includes zero is classified NOT_ESTABLISHED... not silently reported as a directional trend" — all branches pre-committed including the F1 no-slot and F5 reachability vacuous readings.
